text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Flashhh~!
Help meee~!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Please! Protect this in my stead!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Um, do I just hold on to your smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't got time to explain!
Don't you dare hand it to anyone!
If you do, Golshi-chan's gonna melt down to nothing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Whether it melts or not is one thing...
but that desperate look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what happened,
but if a friend is in trouble, I have to help...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, why do you have that?
I've been looking all over for it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Umm... well, this is something
I'm holding onto for Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I simply cannot hand this over...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wait, hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
If I hide here...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(If I lose them in this crowd,
I should be able to get away...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I told you to wait...
Aargh, there are way too many people!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...What is up with that~?!
Just snatching someone's smartphone out of nowhere~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! This smartphone...
It belonged to Jordan-san...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...?
You were running away without even knowing anything...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I am truly sorry.
To think this was yet another one of Golshi-san's pranks."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's fine already. But man~, Flash-san's
moves were razor sharp and her tight turns were insane~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My run from earlier?
Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Hiding, slipping through the crowds...
This might be useful for race positioning too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gained a new realization, Eishin Flash's
movements were even more polished from the very next day!
